$comment: NORMATIVE cross-language conformance corpus for the dr.dsh carrier. Read by crates/dr-dsh-proto (include_str!) and packages/protocol (node:fs). Both implementations assert against these exact bytes in CI; changing a vector is a wire-breaking change and needs a protocol version bump. Header layout (18 bytes, big-endian): magic 'DR' | ver_major u16 | ver_minor u16 | frame_type u16 | flags u16 | stream_id u32 | payload_len u32.

frames.name: empty ping on the control stream
data carrying three bytes on stream 3
window update granting one kilobyte on stream 5

rejections.name: declared payload one byte above the cap
